title: Headless Honest Hearts start (HonestHearts.esm): the broadcast (NVDLC02MQ00 10), Jed met at the Northern Passage (20), the caravan's terms (30), the departure and the intro slides (100); docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: New game, the player out of Doc Mitchell's house (VCG01 done). Once the player is out of the house cell the add-on's quest script (NVDLC02MQ00Script) waits 5 s, then sets Happy Trails Expedition (NVDLC02MQ00) 10 and shows its two loaded messages (closed as the player's OK would). Travel stand-in: move_player to Jed at the Northern Passage.

Jed's first greeting ('Heard my little broadcast'): its end script sets 20. Then 'let's do it' (CaravanMasterTopic000), 'ready to go' (JedTopic026, the alone-and-light answer) and 'why the weight limit?' (JedTopic002), whose end script sets 30: the player knows the terms.

actions.label: Jed: let's do it (alone and light)

actions.text: Jed is essential until stage 100 (its result clears it), so a fight before the departure knocks him out and his script's fail branch (255 when dead below 100) cannot run; the caravan guards' scripts likewise [observed: NVDLC02JedSCRIPT, MQ00 stage 100]. This chain leaves with the caravan instead: the main chain's departure.

The line starts NVDLC02IntroSlides, whose script moves the player into the slide room; the room's trigger (OnTriggerEnter, physics sensors stand in) starts the narrator's SayTo chain, whose last SayToDone sets MQ00 100 (the arrival in Zion).

actions.label: milestone: Happy Trails Expedition done (intro slides said)
